blocked.infected: {{title}} was blocked: it failed the virus scan and was deleted. Upload a clean copy.
blocked.failed: {{title}} was blocked: it could not be scanned. Upload it again.

upload.heading: Add a document
upload.fileHint: A JPEG, PNG or PDF of at most 25 MB. It can be opened once it has been scanned.
upload.title: Title
upload.done: {{title}} was uploaded. It can be opened once it has been scanned.

errors.type: Only a JPEG, PNG or PDF can be added.
errors.size: The file is larger than 25 MB.
errors.rejected: The file was not accepted. Check it and try again.
errors.merged: This record was merged into another. Add the document there.
errors.failed: The file could not be sent. Try again.

retire.heading: Retire {{title}}
retire.note: A retired document stays on the record and is kept for its retention. It leaves the list unless retired documents are shown.

errors.conflict: The document changed since it was read. Close this and try again.
errors.gone: This document is no longer available.

retention.heading: Document retention
retention.note: How long each kind of document is kept. A change applies to documents attached from now on; documents already kept keep their date.

hold.heading: Legal hold on {{title}}
hold.headingPatient: Legal hold on every document of this patient
hold.note: While a hold is active the document is never removed after its retention. Release the hold to let the retention run on.
hold.notePatient: Covers every document of this patient, those added later too, until the hold is released.
hold.done: Legal hold placed on the document.
hold.donePatient: Legal hold placed on the documents of this patient.

holds.heading: Legal holds
holds.note: Documents under a hold are kept past their retention until the hold is released. A hold is placed from the Documents tab of a patient.
holds.confirmDescription: The document or documents may be removed once their retention has passed.
